title: DEFECTIVE!! Coils don’t heat up- read reviews
text: DEFECTIVE!! Coils don’t heat up- read reviews. This toaster is amazing if it worked!! Listen to the other reviews. All the coils don’t heat up. I am SO disappointed because other than that it’s a great toaster but if it doesn’t toast what’s the point?

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CPT-420 Touch to Toast Leverless 2-Slice Toaster, Brushed Stainless Steel
features: Stainless-steel housing with a motorized lift. BPA free
Lcd countdown feature with a blue backlit led function display, Voltage: 120V
Enhanced bagel toasting with cancel, defrost and reheat options
Easy cord wrap for minimal use of your counter space
Toaster comes with a 3 year limited warranty
description: Cuisinart gets extra Credit for its innovative touch to toast lever-less toaster! a touch of a button lowers items into the extra wide slots of our touch to toast lever-less toaster. The easy to use motorized-control, and sleek new control panel with its Blue backlit LCD display with countdown feature, are evidence of cuisines continued dedication to innovation. Great features like one-sided enhanced bagel toasting, reheat and defrost controls, audible alert signal, and 7 shade settings are all included in this elegant, Brushed Stainless Steel toaster.
